/**
 * Callbacks used when interacting with an server via an `IExchangeClient` in the
 * context of synchronizing changes to the message list.
 *
 * These callbacks allow the `IExchangeClient` instance to perform local operation on
 * the folder that is being synchronized.
 */
[scriptable, uuid(dec2ddd5-b5a2-4724-bfc7-e5de31840f76)]
interface IExchangeMessageSyncListener : nsISupports
{
  /**
   * Called when a new message has been created on the server.
   *
   * @param id - The ID for the new message.
   * @param headerBlock - The RFC5322-style email headers for the message.
   * @param isRead - Is the message "Read" on the server?
   * @param isFlagged - Is the message "Marked" on the server?
   * @param preview - A short text preview of the message body?
   */
  void onMessageCreated(in AUTF8String id,
                        in IHeaderBlock headerBlock,
                        in unsigned long messageSize,
                        in boolean isRead,
                        in boolean isFlagged,
                        in AUTF8String preview);

  /**
   * Called when an existing message has been updated on the server.
   *
   * Implementations are expected to return `NS_MSG_MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND` if the
   * message does not exist locally.
   *
   * @param id - The ID for the updated message.
   * @param headerBlock - The RFC5322-style email headers for the message.
   * @param isRead - Is the message "Read" on the server?
   * @param isFlagged - Is the message "Marked" on the server?
   * @param preview - A short text preview of the message body
   */
  void onMessageUpdated(in AUTF8String id,
                        in IHeaderBlock headerblock,
                        in unsigned long messageSize,
                        in boolean isRead,
                        in boolean isFlagged,
                        in AUTF8String preview);
